title: Welcome points are granted on the first order only
intent: Sign in as the prepared customer, who has never ordered. Buy any one product and pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242, noting the order total shown at checkout. Look at the loyalty balance on the account overview. Then buy one more product the same way, again noting the order total at checkout, and look at the loyalty balance again.

assertions.description: Loyalty balance on the account overview after the first paid order
Loyalty balance on the account overview after the second paid order
